FRAME / EYELINE / CONTINUITY: East viewpoint sees his left profile; hand reaches the same side of the seat, not across his body.

FRAME / EYELINE / CONTINUITY: Hold EAST-side geography through the approach; Arnavaz is behind Zahhak, not confronting him.
END STATE AND EDIT
Zahhak stands at the SOUTH edge of the NORTH upper seat facing SOUTH, staff planted. Arnavaz stands northeast of him, one arm's length behind his left shoulder, looking at his back. Guards A/B hold southeast/southwest outer marks.
